text:
maria_cs: Kicking off priming for ZenithEdge dedicated pool (go-live next week). Need quick checklist: quotas, autoscale behavior, warm KV priming, and a burst load test. tagging owners.
kevin_eng: on it. Do we have their SLOs/traffic shape?
olivia_sre: 99.5% <120ms p95, frequent 60s bursts up to ~2k rps every few minutes, steady baseline ~300 rps. Payloads are small (~150-250 tokens).
jamal_sre: Suggest two-phase run: 1) long steady-state steady 300 rps for 60m to prime caches, 2) laddered bursts up to 2k rps for 60s holds. We'll watch tail latencies and 5xxs.
maria_cs: Owners: network (Ben), autoscale/infra (Kevin), warmup & priming (Olivia), SRE-run tests (Jamal), CS coordination (me / Sam).
ben_net: FYI their perimeter blocks unknown IP ranges. Please ensure our warmup runner IPs are allow-listed: 34.82.110.5/32 and 35.196.20.10/32. If they NAT, we need their egress IPs.
kevin_eng: Pool sizing visible: 4 GPUs, 2500 qps/GPU -> theoretical 10k qps. We'll reserve 25% headroom during go-live so usable cap ~7.5k. Autoscale policy currently: add one GPU at +70% sustained; remove at <40% for 10m. Might tweak for bursty profile.
olivia_sre: warmup plan: push many distinct prefixes and short completions to fill KV caches and attention kernels. Keyspace plan: user_pref:0..200000 and recent_prompt_top100.
jamal_sre: Important: during warmup use sequence length 32 tokens to populate KV and attention. If we only use full-length 512 tokens we won't hit common short-path kernels.
maria_cs: sample warmup command for ops (run from our warmup-hosts):
```
# simple vegeta-style steady run to prime (replace HOST)
hey -n 216000 -c 50 -qps 300 http://HOST/api/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"warmup prompt <USER_ID>"}'
```
kevin_eng: Also add a synthetic burst script that ramps 300 -> 800 -> 1400 -> 2000 rps in 30s steps and hold 60s at top. We'll monitor GPU utilization and throttles.
deploy-bot: reserved-pool 'zenith-prod' activated at 2934567800 :white_check_mark:
olivia_sre: warmup helper: `python tools/warmup_kv.py --keys 0-200000 --rate 50 --seq-len 32 --host $HOST` will push user-prefixed keys. I'll drop the script in the shared runbook.
ben_net: confirm firewall rule request sent to customer. Waiting on their NAT details.
sam_cs: Customer side confirmed Thu availability 09:00 UTC for steady run and 11:30 UTC for burst. They'll have eng on-call.
jamal_sre: Actionable checks before steady run: 1) allowlist done, 2) warmup script smoke, 3) autoscale threshold dry-run, 4) rollback runbook validated. Who owns rollback test?
kevin_eng: I'll validate rollback + cooldown script and run a dry-run in staging Tue.
maria_cs: I'll consolidate action items and send calendar invites. Please add any extra preflight noise. Reminder: capture customer feedback during test (latency lens, token-level cost spike).
olivia_sre: one more note: include cache-hit metrics for prefix/kv hits in dashboard. We'll need those during analysis.
kevin_eng: Ack. I'll add a dedicated dashboard and a tracing tag `zenith-priming` for the runs.
maria_cs: Perfect. We'll reconvene Thu 08:15 UTC for a 15m preflight check. :thumbsup:
